description: This Java source file defines the SerialManager class responsible for managing serial communication. It includes a data listener to process incoming data, references external classes for link management and connection state, and contains commented-out code that suggests methods for discovering available serial ports and port type identification.

classes.name: SerialManager
classes.description: Manages serial port data reception and connection status, acting as a coordinator for serial communication within the system.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Callback method invoked when new data arrives on the serial port; processes the data using LinkManager.
